explanation: This fires only at the GO step and only in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 94 to 99), when the previous trial was unrewarded; the first unrewarded trial in a row gives about 3-6, and the second or later one in a row gives about 8-10, whichever action is chosen. It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, at every GO step before trial 94 or after a rewarded trial (at most about 2 just after a loss streak), so it is 0 nearly everywhere.
